target_customer: Consumers who want to make and share music mashups without DJ skills, paying by subscription
problem: Making mashups needs DJ skills and tools. Mixy blends vocals and beats of any songs in seconds on an iPhone.

founders.name: Joe Kennedy
prior_employers: CoinList (via acquisition of his consumer social startup)
previous_startups: Consumer social startup acquired by CoinList, where he led product
founders.background_notes: YC page says the founders met as teen tech YouTubers in 2008 and built iPhone apps together from 2009. Collectively they worked at Apple, Instagram and Skillshare.

competitors.name: MashApp
competitors.what: Licensed mashup app with major label catalogs
competitors.traction_then: launched in the US in February 2025

competitors.name: Hook
competitors.what: AI remix app with a Downtown licensing deal
competitors.traction_then: announced licensing deal the prior year

technical_complexity.rationale: On device or local AI stem separation, beat matching and mashup rendering in a polished iOS app is hard for two people, but built on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Mashup tooling can be copied, and licensing of music is unresolved, so scale could draw label or platform pressure.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A Billboard piece linked MashApp's launch to reports of Spotify remix tools; no copy aimed at Mixy found.

market_need_then: Strong consumer pull shown by usage: the YC page reports 1.5M users in 3 months and a #1 Music ranking on 2025-06-19, with 350k pre-orders from TikTok prototypes per Know Your Meme coverage.

identity.logo: Wordmark plus a separate logomark, per the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful consumer tone: live out your DJ dreams

branding.brand_signature: Founder Joe Kennedy's TikTok account mixyjoe showing prototypes, and the Make Mashups tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Know Your Meme has an entry on the Mixy app; TikTok prototype videos drove over 350k pre-orders before the 2025-06-19 launch.

brand_strength.rationale: Viral TikTok launch, a Know Your Meme entry and a #1 Music chart position show real brand pull; the name is short and friendly, though the domain is not an exact .com.

outcome_analysis: Mixy launched an iOS mashup app on 2025-06-19 after a TikTok prototype campaign, reached the top of the Music chart and reports 1.5M users and about $20k MRR in the YC listing. The founders have a long consumer app history. The open risks are music licensing and platform dependency; no exit or shutdown found.
notes: Round rests on aggregators only: VCBacked and FundedIQ list a $500K pre-seed in 2025-12 with Y Combinator only, probably YC's standard deal. Cross-check search found no press or filing. The YC page reports $200k in donations, which is not equity. Usage claims (1.5M users, 15M or 18M mashups) are company figures and differ across YC pages. Founded year 2024 is inferred from the App Store listing id and the 2025-02 prototype; treat as approximate. Education not found.
